7. We calculate that 8 additional pieces of rough sandstone will produce the additional 2 smooth sandstone to make another 2 smooth sandstone slabs, bringing the total crafted to 6 smooth sandstone slabs.
8. Once again, we proceed by gathering 8 more rough sandstone pieces.
9. Craft the 2 new smooth sandstone to increase the available amount.
10. Proceeding with the last remaining smooth sandstone: Craft the last 2 smooth sandstone slabs to get the final 2 needed slabs.
11. Collecting these final 2 smooth sandstone results in the complete crafting chain leading up to the crafting of the smooth sandstone slabs.
12. After all the collections and crafts, you should have the 6 required smooth sandstone slabs successfully crafted!
